about.heading: Delicious, enjoyable, happy
about.lead: Founded in 2012, EMS International Trading imports high-quality organic and halal food, cosmetics and more — mainly from the Mediterranean, Russia, Belarus and the CIS — and supplies them to Japan and other Asian countries.
about.mission: To import and provide high-quality food at affordable prices.
about.mission_text: As the authorised importer and distributor of EL KHABIA and BIOSANARE products, and the exclusive importer of many well-loved brands, we work closely with our partners to guarantee quality and taste.
message: Imported products are becoming indispensable to our daily lives. Goods from many countries feel closer than ever — yet there are still so many hidden gems waiting to be discovered.
Our goal is to bring them to you, closer and more affordably.
What we value most is careful communication with each of our partners abroad. By understanding one another's culture, food habits and values, we practise trade that is sustainable for everyone.
We will keep working so that our products bring you something delicious, enjoyable and happy.

values.title: Quality
values.text: We are committed to reliable service and products. In every step — from development and packaging to shipping, delivery and support — our goal is to meet and exceed our customers' expectations.

values.title: Innovation
values.text: Our customers are at the centre of every idea. We keep finding better ways to source, deliver and serve.

values.title: Integrity
values.text: We act with honesty and integrity, and never compromise the truth.

values.title: Customer service excellence
values.text: We are passionate about meeting our customers' needs and honouring every commitment — and proud of it.

products.heading: Good food, honestly sourced
products.lead: We source directly from producers across the Mediterranean (Tunisia, Morocco, Spain, France, Italy, Greece), Russia, Belarus and India — safe, high-quality products for a changing market.
products.price_note: For prices, availability and wholesale terms, please contact us.

categories.title: Pasta, grains & flour
categories.text: MAKFA is the largest maker of pasta, wheat flour and grains in Russia and the CIS, operating in 35 countries and number one on the Russian pasta market. Its premium pasta is made from the finest durum wheat semolina; its flour comes from wheat grown on the company's own farms without relying on pesticides or chemical fertilisers.
items: Cereals with no added sugar or additives

categories.title: Natural halal cheese
categories.text: Preservative-free soft and semi-hard cheeses made with advanced Italian technology. Every bonfesto product is halal certified — for everyday use and professional kitchens alike. The cooking range is made for cafés, bars and restaurant chefs.

categories.title: Honey
categories.text: A modern, fast-growing honey company from Belarus, producing natural honey products for the food industry with the best of its knowledge and technology.

categories.title: Confectionery
categories.text: Ranked 17th in the global "Top 100 Candy Companies", with 19 factories and 11 logistics centres across Russia and a heritage of some 200 years. Its signature natural milk chocolate dates from 1966.

categories.title: Premium Deglet Nour dates
categories.text: Deglet Nour — traditionally known as "the light of the dates" — is called the king of dates for its natural golden colour, distinctive flavour and soft flesh. We offer it plain, stuffed, and as 100% date syrup (halal, USDA and ECOCERT organic).

categories.title: Spices, herbs & harissa
categories.text: Ready-mixed blends that make professional flavours easy at home. Harissa — North Africa's all-purpose condiment of chili, olive oil and spices — alongside halal-certified single spices and herbs.
items: Couscous, chicken, fish, grill, BBQ and sausage blends

categories.title: Tahini
categories.text: A rich paste of 100% white sesame, slightly looser than Japanese neri-goma and easy to use in cooking and baking — for hummus, dressings, dips and shira-ae. Halal certified.

categories.title: Extra virgin olive oil & organic pantry
categories.text: Our extra virgin olive oil comes from 100% Tunisian olives grown at the Arisfa farm at the foot of the Zaghouan mountains — more than 21,000 olive trees on 4,855,200 m² of rugged, rocky land. Alongside it: EU-organic sherry and Pedro Ximénez vinegars, organic olives and preserves.

categories.title: Gourmet tuna fillets
categories.text: Only the rare belly cut of small yellowfin tuna, processed entirely by hand to a traditional Tunisian recipe — nothing like supermarket tuna. Halal and Kosher certified.

categories.title: Essential oils
categories.text: Pure essential oils for aromatherapy, from the ethical brand EMS co-founded in India.
items: Neem, niaouli, juniper berry, bitter orange peel

categories.title: Gift boxes
categories.text: Seasonal gift sets of our favourite products — and custom boxes for corporate gifts.

categories.title: Cosmetics, amenities & lifestyle
categories.text: Beyond food, we supply organic cosmetics and halal amenities for hotels, restaurants and airlines, together with interior goods and fashion accessories.
items: Organic face, body, hair and foot care

services.heading: Partners from sourcing to the table
services.lead: We respond to changing consumer needs with organic and halal food, lifestyle goods and the services around them.

items.title: Wholesale
items.text: We buy directly from producers, without intermediaries, so we can offer the best products at the best prices. We supply department stores, supermarkets, organic retailers, wholesalers, restaurants and halal shops across Japan.

items.title: OEM & private label
items.text: Working with the product development teams of our partner companies in Spain and Tunisia, we create OEM and private-label products for specific customer needs — and build sustainable business together.

items.title: Halal catering
items.text: Healthy, fresh and delicious food makes a real difference to how people feel and work. Our catering serves authentic halal dishes made with ingredients from the Mediterranean, mainly Tunisia, backed by our experience and hospitality.

items.title: Business travel & private tours
items.text: Through our travel agency partners we arrange domestic and international flights and hotels for business trips, and plan private tours — from luxury holidays to adventure trips — with local partner operators.

privacy.heading: Privacy policy
intro: EMS International Trading Co., Ltd. ("we") recognises the importance of personal information and complies with the Act on the Protection of Personal Information and related laws and guidelines.

sections.title: 1. Purpose of use
body: We use personal information only to the extent necessary for the following purposes:
list: Responding to enquiries and requests for quotes and samples
Carrying out transactions, shipping and invoicing
Providing information about our products, services and events

sections.title: 2. Provision to third parties
body: We do not provide personal information to third parties without the individual's consent, except where permitted by law.

sections.title: 3. Security
body: We take necessary and appropriate measures to prevent leakage, loss or damage of personal information.

sections.title: 4. Disclosure and correction
body: If you request disclosure, correction or deletion of your personal information, we will respond promptly after confirming your identity.

sections.title: 5. This website
body: This website does not use cookies, analytics or advertising trackers. The contact form opens your own email app and does not send or store data on our server. Web fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which receives your IP address as part of normal web requests.
